title: Relative tensor section algebra and canonical evaluation map
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $L$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Tensor powers use the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], including $L^{\otimes0}=\mathcal O_X$. A relative section algebra of $(f,L)$ consists of quasi-coherent affine-basis graded algebra data $A$ [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra] and additive isomorphisms $A(V)_n\simeq\Gamma(f^{-1}V,L^{\otimes n})$ for every affine base open $V$ and every $n\geq0$. They respect the structural scalar action, the degree-zero unit, multiplication via $L^{\otimes(m+n)}\simeq L^{\otimes m}\otimes L^{\otimes n}$, and all affine-open restrictions. For a scheme chart $j:W\to X$ over $V$, evaluate a homogeneous section by module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], the actual $1\otimes s$ adjunction unit, and the canonical power comparison [def-sc-tensor-pullback-power-comparison]. A map $r:X\to\operatorname{Proj}_T(A)$ [def-nagata-relative-proj] is canonical if it lies over $T$ and has the following chart characterization: for every open immersion $j:W\to X$, affine $V\subset T$ with $W\subset j^{-1}f^{-1}V$, trivialization $e:j^*L\simeq\mathcal O_W$, and ring map $\alpha:A(V)\to\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$ whose value on every homogeneous section of every degree is its evaluated section expressed using the tensor power $e^{\otimes n}:j^*L^{\otimes n}\simeq\mathcal O_W$ of $e$ [def-trf-space-line-module-proj-input], whenever the image of the irrelevant ideal generates the unit ideal, $r\circ j$ equals the standard morphism induced by $\alpha$ into $\operatorname{Proj}(A(V))$ followed by its relative Proj chart inclusion. The chart formula includes degree zero and imposes no hypothesis that $A_0=\mathcal O_T$, no degree-one generation, and no existence assertion.
